pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍantā pesale bhikkhū omasanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.3: jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi hīnenapi akkosena khuṃsenti vambhenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍantā pesale bhikkhū omasissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.6: jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi hīnenapi akkosena khuṃsessanti vambhessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.7: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍantā pesale bhikkhū omasatha jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi hīnenapi akkosena khuṃsetha vambhethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍantā pesale bhikkhū omasissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.13: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave takkasilāyaṃ aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa nandivisālo nāma balibaddo ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.2: athakho bhikkhave nandivisālo balibaddo taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.3: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ sahassena abbhudaṃ karohi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.5: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ sahassena abbhudaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.7: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sakaṭasataṃ atibandhitvā nandivisālaṃ balibaddaṃ yuñjitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.9: athakho bhikkhave nandivisālo balibaddo tattheva aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.10: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sahassena parājito pajjhāyi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.11: athakho bhikkhave nandivisālo balibaddo taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.13: tathā hi panāhaṃ bho tayā sahassena parājitoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.14: kissa pana maṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa akūṭaṃ kūṭavādena pāpesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.15: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ dvīhi sahassehi abbhudaṃ karohi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.17: mā ca maṃ akūṭaṃ kūṭavādena pāpesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.18: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ dvīhi sahassehi abbhudaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.20: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sakaṭasataṃ atibandhitvā nandivisālaṃ balibaddaṃ yuñjitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.22: athakho bhikkhave nandivisālo balibaddo sakaṭasataṃ atibaddhaṃ pavaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.29: tadāpi me bhikkhave amanāpā khuṃsanā vambhanā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.30: kimaṅgaṃ panetarahi manāpā bhavissati khuṃsanā vambhanā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.32: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.2: dasahi ākārehi omasati jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi akkosenapi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.4: dve jātiyo hīnā ca jāti ukkaṭṭhā ca jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.6: caṇḍālajāti veṇajāti nesādajāti rathakārajāti pukkusajāti esā hīnā nāma jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.8: khattiyajāti brāhmaṇajāti esā ukkaṭṭhā nāma jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.10: dve nāmāni hīnañca nāmaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.12: avakaṇṇakaṃ javakaṇṇakaṃ dhaniṭṭhakaṃ saviṭṭhakaṃ kulavaḍḍhakaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acitīkataṃ etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.14: buddhapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ saṅghapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ citīkataṃ etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.16: dve gottāni hīnañca gottaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.18: bhāradvājagottaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acitīkataṃ etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.20: gotamagottaṃ moggallānagottaṃ kaccāyanagottaṃ vāseṭṭhagottaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ citīkataṃ etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.22: dve kammāni hīnañca kammaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.24: koṭṭhakakammaṃ pupphachaḍḍakakammaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acitīkataṃ etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.26: kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ citīkataṃ etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.28: dve sippāni hīnañca sippaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.30: naḷakārasippaṃ kumbhakārasippaṃ pesakārasippaṃ cammakārasippaṃ nahāpitasippaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acitīkataṃ etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.32: muddhā gaṇanā lekhā tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ citīkataṃ etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.36: dve liṅgāni hīnañca liṅgaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.38: atidīghaṃ atirassaṃ atikaṇhaṃ accodātaṃ etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.40: nātidīghaṃ nātirassaṃ nātikaṇhaṃ nāccodātaṃ etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.46: dve akkosā hīno ca akkoso ukkaṭṭho ca akkoso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.48: oṭṭhosi meṇḍosi goṇosi gadrabhosi tiracchānagatosi nerayikosi natthi tuyhaṃ sugati duggatiyeva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāti yakārena vā bhakārena vā kāṭakoṭacikāya vā eso hīno nāma akkoso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.50: paṇḍitosi byattosi medhāvīsi bahussutosi dhammakathikosi natthi tuyhaṃ duggati sugatiyeva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāti eso ukkaṭṭho nāma akkoso.
